intersection.headline: Nike returns to Formula 1 as official apparel partner from 2027, replacing Puma
intersection.summary: Nike becomes F1's Official Apparel and Uniform Supplier on a long-term deal, ending Puma's run. The deal also covers F1 Academy. A limited Las Vegas Grand Prix capsule collection launches this weekend, with more collections and fan experiences planned across the calendar. It is a major shift in sportswear's F1 landscape, with Adidas already in the sport via Mercedes and Audi.

intersection.headline: Adidas crowned Marketing Week Brand of the Year 2026 after its bounce back
intersection.summary: Adidas beat Allica Bank, Currys, Nationwide, Tony's Chocolonely and Waitrose to the title. The award combines a jury of marketing experts with a reader vote. Marketing Week ties the win to the brand's turnaround, including a strong quarter after the World Cup.

sports.headline: LA Sparks near record $750m sale, more than double the previous WNBA franchise price
sports.summary: Private equity billionaire José E. Feliciano and Kwanza Jones are reportedly close to buying the Sparks from Mark Walter for $750m. The previous WNBA record was the $300m Connecticut Sun sale. The price is about 25 times the Sparks' 2026 revenue, which Sportico says is a high for a major US league. It signals big investor appetite for women's sport.

sports.headline: Infantino faces two challengers in the FIFA presidential election
sports.summary: AP reports that Gianni Infantino, after 11 years as FIFA president, now has two official election opponents: France's Diallo and Japan's Tashima. This is a significant governance story for world football. The link goes to AP's sports feed on US News, as I could not find a direct article URL.

sports.headline: WHOOP becomes Official Partner of Formula 1 and F1 Academy in a four-year deal
sports.summary: WHOOP is now F1's Official Health & Fitness Wearable Partner. Its band is the first consumer wearable the FIA has approved for in-race use. Live driver heart-rate data goes onto broadcasts from 2027, and WHOOP also backs the all-female F1 Academy. Max Verstappen has said he won't take part, citing privacy.

sports.headline: Valencia Marathon offers €1m bonus for a women's world record
sports.summary: Organisers are openly targeting a women's marathon world record. Any athlete who beats Ruth Chepngetich's 2:09:56 mark will receive a €1m bonus from the Trinidad Alfonso Foundation. The story is a preview of the race, not a result.

fashion.headline: Rihanna and daughter Rocki star in Lady Dior campaign
fashion.summary: WWD has an exclusive on the new Lady Dior campaign. Rihanna and her one-year-old daughter wear matching leather jackets by creative director Jonathan Anderson. Melina Matsoukas directed the campaign film. It is a major cultural and marketing moment for Dior.

fashion.headline: Travis Scott x Nike GTA 6 Air Force 1s get release dates
fashion.summary: The black and white Air Force 1s tied to Rockstar's GTA 6 launch drop on Nike SNKRS on 21 November, then via Cactus Jack on 23 November, at a reported US$130. It is a high-profile sneaker, gaming and culture crossover. Hypebeast and WWD reported it first; I could only retrieve ContentGrip's write-up, so that is the link.

fashion.headline: Prada launches quarterly 'Prada Index' editorial project
fashion.summary: Prada is debuting Index, a magazine-style guidebook. The first 400-page issue covers its 2026 initiatives across art, fashion, film, design and sailing. It packages the brand's cultural programming as its own publishing format.

marketing.headline: How brands are tapping the GTA 6 launch, from Logitech's day off to a Miami Heat 'Vice City' game
marketing.summary: Adweek looks at how Logitech, KFC, AT&T, Spectrum and others are using the GTA 6 release. Logitech gave all 7,000 staff the day off, and the Miami Heat staged a Vice City-themed NBA game. Adweek says preorders have reached $1.5bn.

marketing.headline: How Celsius doubled down on sports marketing campaigns in 2026
marketing.summary: Digiday reports that Celsius is leaning more on partnerships with major sports leagues, college athletics and high-profile athletic events. The link goes to Digiday's marketing section, as I could not find a direct article URL.

marketing.headline: Consulting firms revive their marketing ambitions in the C-suite the holdcos covet
marketing.summary: Deloitte Digital and Accenture Song have started selling marketing services in the C-suite with a fresh push. The briefing looks at what this means for traditional holding companies. It is relevant to the CMO and agency landscape.

marketing.headline: Why more brands are paying creators to make their ads
marketing.summary: Digiday explains that creator-led production is the fastest-growing segment of the influencer economy and what is driving the investment. It cites a global influencer market of about $116bn.
